verdict.rationale: OpenTofu claims a large ecosystem (3,900+ providers, 23,600+ modules) covering every major cloud/SaaS, is Terraform-compatible (drop-in replacement, reuses Terraform providers/modules), and hands-on probes confirm real provider-based plan/apply/destroy workflows function correctly. Community feedback corroborates easy migration from Terraform and functional parity, though some note reliance on upstream providers.
